name: Huércal-Overa (Spain)
description: Garnet field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Huércal-Overa (a shield with an eagle crest and an inscribed border).
history: Huércal-Overa adopted its arms and flag officially on 19 November 2013, the arms having been used since their grant by King Alfonso XIII in 1912; the flag is a rectangular garnet (Pantone 1955) cloth one and a half times longer than wide, charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
